messages.subject: Executive Profile | Corporate Affairs, Strategic Partnerships & Government Relations | International Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Monte-Carlo Société des Bains de Mer Recruitment Team,

I am reaching out regarding senior corporate opportunities where government relations, strategic partnerships, external affairs, ESG and stakeholder leadership intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, ESG, social performance, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest fit is in Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates involving institutional relations, strategic partnerships, corporate affairs, responsible business and country-facing leadership.

Monte-Carlo Société des Bains de Mer's international profile, premium stakeholder environment and strong institutional presence make the Group relevant to my next move. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached a Group-tailored executive CV for review and future matching. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming senior corporate mandates.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
